profile.headline: Full Stack Developer | React, React Native, Python/Django | AI Integrations
profile.summary:
Full Stack Developer building production web and mobile apps, primarily frontend (React, React Native, Vue) backed by Python/Django.
 
At Potentia Analytics, I've built healthcare software including an AI patient chat assistant using AWS Bedrock and led React Native mobile development.
 
I also build and ship my own products: EversVoz (AI pronunciation coaching, live on iOS) and EversPass (full stack photo sharing app).

https://everscode.com
https://github.com/urielcookies
https://blog.everscode.com
https://everscode.com/resume/EversResume2025.pdf

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Full stack developer building healthcare software, primarily on the frontend using React and Vue, with backend work in Python and Django. Built an AI powered patient chat assistant using AWS Bedrock, including both the React chat interface and the backend conversation handling. Led React Native mobile development, including subscription tier integration and app store releases. Implemented multi factor authentication using AWS Cognito and AWS Amplify.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Frontend focused engineer on a digital pathology platform for viewing and analyzing whole slide medical images. Led the migration of core application state from Redux to GraphQL and Apollo Client across major modules. Built a CSV data import wizard in React and ag-Grid, and a real time job monitoring workflow using Formik, Yup, and GraphQL subscriptions. Worked in an Agile environment with Node.js, C# .NET Core, and Jenkins for CI/CD.

positions.title: Full Stack Web Developer
positions.description:
Maintained E-Commerce site.
Technologies - Shopify, JavaScript/jQuery, Python/Django. mySQL

positions.title: Full Stack Web Developer
positions.description: Converted design mockups into production code using JavaScript and jQuery, and maintained a PHP backend with PostgreSQL and AWS S3 for storage driven features. Worked across the full stack, from UI to backend to deployment testing.

positions.title: IT Support
positions.description:
Provided technical support tier 1 and 2 and fixed issues and questions in a timely manner.
Provided basic troubleshooting: 
        Windows and Macintosh operating systems,
        Hardware and software, 
	Projectors, scanners, mobile devices, and printers.
Installed software packages and did daily software checks throughout the PC and Macs
Did some remote PC support (DameWare)
Follow up with customers to ensure issue has been resolved.

volunteerExperiences.description:
Cabling, patching, and LAN troubleshooting.
Resolved tickets in ticketing system.
Setting up workstations in a timely manner.
Performed Imaging process on desktops and notebooks.
Got to learn about Power Shell and encrypting computers
